label: 164 storage as endogenous
definition: Endogenous storage energy-vs-AS co-opt (G5): run163 + ercot_storage_as_endogenous + RTOLCAP reserve-supply cap. The battery CHOOSES energy vs upward-AS inside the multi-product co-opt (full power cap, room competes with arbitrage on the same cap, priced by the per-product AS demand curves) — REPLACING the measured 60-Day DAM battery AS-award reservation. Cleared storage AS counts toward the measured RTOLCAP online supply (which already includes batteries); the cap is a pure supply bound (the additive ORDC adder is gated off — the co-opt prices endogenously), so acute/tail HOLDS vs run163: acute 8/24/26 $24.6/$21.7/$30.2, 2025 clean. Measured-vs-modeled split (mean MW, storage-first UPPER bound): modeled AS 2427/4036/5680 vs measured 1249/2045/2824 (~2x), AS share 95/93/89% — AS-dominated and rising with the fleet as in reality, but over-holds AS vs the measured level (documented residual, NOT retuned to it; the split is the LP's choice, validated against the award not pinned to it). 2023/24 annual under-price inherited from run163's broad-May energy-base residual, not this lever.
